rationale: This plan directly addresses all six elements of the task brief: (1) Claim count and status split via claim_volume with figure=true to produce the status distribution chart; (2) Denial rate via denial_rate with all_claims denominator for comprehensive context; (3) Fraud flag prevalence via fraud_prevalence to quantify how common it is; (4) Financial amounts (billed, allowed, paid) with both totals and per-claim means via financial_summary; (5) Monthly claim volume trends via monthly_trend keyed on adjudication_date; (6) Comprehensive one-page report via write_report with denominators visible for rates and citations linking findings to source artifacts. All required artifacts are produced: status chart, monthly trend chart and table, financial summary table, and report with embedded metrics.
